notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for ordinary multi-attribute Update/Reflect projection. The source uses only the standard C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, multi-attribute FOM, endpoint, and callback configuration. It verifies a publisher's two-attribute update, complete projection for a subscriber declaring both attributes, selective projection for first-only and second-only subscribers, per-update user tags and producer metadata, owner loopback exclusion, and standard federation cleanup without asserting provider-specific names, registries, headers, or implementation behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador object publication, registration, and multi-attribute update with FederateAmbassador discovery and reflection callbacks projected by each subscription attribute set
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador object-attribute declaration/update declarations and FederateAmbassador discovery/reflection declarations
